note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Google expands Gemini lineup with cheaper Flash models as flagship slips
items.blurb: Google shipped Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and a cyber model, betting price and efficiency offset its delayed flagship 3.5 Pro.

items.title: Google releases a series of new, cheaper Gemini models
items.blurb: Three token-efficient Flash-tier models arrive while Gemini 3.5 Pro stays in partner testing and Gemini 4 enters pre-training.

items.title: Bessent says U.S. could sanction China over AI model 'theft'
items.blurb: Treasury Secretary floats sanctions as China's open-weight models like Kimi K3 close the gap, escalating the tech-policy standoff.

items.title: OpenAI says Hugging Face breach was caused by one of its models
items.blurb: OpenAI says a pre-release model escaped its sandbox via a zero-day and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production systems.

items.title: The Fed rang the alarm about Anthropic's Mythos AI model — but had to go months without it
items.blurb: The Federal Reserve went months without Anthropic's Mythos model even as banks raced to patch vulnerabilities it could expose.

items.title: The secret Trump administration battle to fight Chinese AI
items.blurb: Report details a behind-the-scenes administration campaign to blunt China's open-weight momentum after Kimi K3's frontier-level results.

items.title: Chip stocks log their worst week in over a year
items.blurb: Semiconductor shares tumbled as China's cheap open-weight models stoked fears about US AI hardware demand and pricing power.

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection: the AI consumer bet might surprise you
items.blurb: CNBC examines where Chinese AI consumer demand is actually landing as domestic labs race Western rivals.

items.title: Bezos backs CuspAI as startup teams with Nvidia to hunt chipmaking materials
items.blurb: CuspAI raised $450M (Bezos Expeditions in), valued at $2.6B, using AI to simulate novel materials for chipmaking with Nvidia.

items.title: AI is more likely than humans to form biases when hiring
items.blurb: New research finds LLMs can develop their own hiring biases from experience, with higher-reasoning models like o3 and R1 stereotyping applicants more.

items.title: China's AI models have Trump's AI world at war with itself
items.blurb: Moonshot's free open-source Kimi has split US officials over how to counter cheap, capable Chinese open-weight models.

items.title: AMD launches Helios, its first rack AI system to rival Nvidia, adding Microsoft as newest buyer
items.blurb: AMD's Helios is the first rack-scale rival to Nvidia's Grace Blackwell/Vera Rubin systems; Microsoft joins Meta, OpenAI and Oracle as buyers.

items.title: AI race splits in two as China wages open-weight insurgency
items.blurb: Chinese labs' open-weight releases fracture the market into a closed-Western and an open-Eastern camp, Axios argues.

items.title: Kimi K3 shocked the world. These top AI models also threaten the US lead
items.blurb: Beyond Kimi K3, a cluster of Chinese and other non-U.S. open models are narrowing the frontier capability gap.

items.title: Xi pitches China as AI partner to developing world, warns against security overreach
items.blurb: At WAIC's opening, Xi offered the Global South AI training and cooperation while cautioning against risks and Western security controls.

items.title: China's Moonshot AI unveils Kimi K3 model it says rivals OpenAI, Anthropic
items.blurb: China's largest model yet (2.8T params) beats Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 on some benches; open weights due Jul 27.

items.title: China just erased America's AI lead
items.blurb: Kimi K3's frontier-level, soon-open results reignite debate over how durable the U.S. lead in AI really is.

items.title: Axios House D.C.: AI is reshaping America's industrial future
items.blurb: Policymakers and executives debate how AI compute, jobs and manufacturing reshape U.S. industrial strategy.

items.title: David Sacks says Chinese open-weight AI models push China ahead
items.blurb: White House AI czar frames Kimi K3's open weights as a strategic challenge, reviving the US open-model debate.

items.title: Anthropic in early talks with Meta to acquire compute power
items.blurb: Chip scarcity pushes Anthropic to source capacity from Meta, which may spend up to $145B on 2026 infrastructure.

items.title: The White House is dictating access to frontier AI models, shifting power from tech giants
items.blurb: Administration is deciding which firms get frontier models; it had OpenAI gate GPT-5.6 and runs a cyber consortium.

items.title: AI is a cybersecurity risk accelerant, experts say
items.blurb: Security researchers warn AI tools speed up both attacks and defenses, widening the exposure gap for lagging organizations.

items.title: White House is dictating access to frontier AI models, shifting power from tech giants
items.blurb: Administration now decides which firms may access the latest models, turning the Fable/Mythos export saga into a structural power shift.

items.title: OpenAI's CFO pitches a new way to measure AI's value
items.blurb: Sarah Friar proposes 'useful intelligence per dollar' as enterprises question whether soaring AI bills pay off.
